title: When Better Artificial Intelligence Widens the Adoption Gap in Health Care
abstract: arXiv:2611.20561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) can assist healthcare providers in clinical practice or replace services for which they are paid. We model how provider influence shapes two policy choices. The first is adoption, the share of cases in which coverage is switched to care using AI. The second is the review requirement, the number of paid reviews that must accompany AI when it is used in clinical care. Assistance can lower providers' costs and increase their profits while leaving paid reviews unaffected. However, increasingly capable AI may support autonomous use that can replace reviews and reduce providers' profits. Provider gains from adoption first rise and subsequently fall as AI capability improves. Hence, providers oppose sufficiently autonomous AI if their lost income from reviews exceeds savings from better assistance. Opposition to AI adoption arises earlier for AI that displaces more reviews. When providers can influence adoption but

translated_title: 当更先进的人工智能扩大医疗保健领域的采用差距时
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）可以在临床实践中协助医疗服务提供者，或取代其赖以获得报酬的服务。我们通过建模分析医疗服务提供者的影响力如何塑造两项政策选择：第一项是采用率，即覆盖范围中转换为使用AI进行治疗的病例比例；第二项是审查要求，即在临床护理中使用AI时必须伴随的付费审查次数。辅助型AI可以降低医疗服务提供者的成本并增加其利润，同时不影响付费审查。然而，能力日益增强的AI可能支持自主使用，从而取代审查并减少医疗服务提供者的利润。随着AI能力的提升，医疗服务提供者从采用AI中获得的收益先上升后下降。因此，如果因审查被取代而损失的收入超过了获得更好辅助所带来的节约，医疗服务提供者就会反对足够自主的AI。对于取代更多审查的AI，针对AI采用的反对会出现得更早。当医疗服务提供者能够影响采用决策时……
tldr: 本文通过模型分析医疗服务提供者的影响力如何决定AI在医疗保健中的采用与审查政策，发现随着AI能力提升提供者收益先升后降，当AI足够自主以至于取代付费审查、使其收入损失超过辅助带来的节约时，提供者便会反对AI采用，且AI取代审查越多反对出现得越早。
en_tdlr: This paper models how healthcare provider influence shapes AI adoption and review requirements in medicine, showing that provider gains from adoption first rise then fall as AI capability improves, leading providers to oppose sufficiently autonomous AI when lost review income exceeds savings from better assistance, with opposition emerging earlier for AI that displaces more reviews.
